verses.text: But now, you people of Israel whom Yahweh has chosen to serve him, listen to me.
Yahweh, the one who created you and helps you, says this:
I will pour water on your dry land
They will grow up like [SIM] grass grows along the water,
Some of them will say, ‘I belong to Yahweh,’
Yahweh, the King of Israel, the one who saves us, the Commander of the armies of angels, says this:
If there is anyone like me [RHQ],
My people, do not be afraid.
All those who make idols are foolish,
Only foolish people [RHQ] would make idols in a mold,
Those who make idols and those who worship them will be ashamed.
Metalworkers stand in front of hot coals
Then a woodcarver takes a big block/piece of wood and he measures it;
Before he carves an idol from that block of wood, he has cut down a cedar tree,
And after he uses part of the tree to make an idol,
He burns part of the wood of the tree to cook his meat and eats the meat and his stomach becomes full,
Then he takes the rest of the wood
Those people are very stupid and ignorant [SAR].
They do not think about what they are doing,
They are very stupid to worship something that if you burn it, it becomes ashes!
Yahweh says, “You descendants of [MTY] Jacob,
I have gotten rid of your sins
The sun and moon and stars in the sky should sing,
Yahweh, who saved you and created you, says this:
I show that the false prophets are liars,
But I always cause to happen what my prophets predict [DOU].
When I say to the rivers, ‘Dry up!’,
When I say about King Cyrus, ‘He will take care of my people like [MET] a shepherd takes care of his sheep,
